Giả lập chuyển động camera cầm tay tự nhiên (handheld camera movement) cho daily vlog

structured_prompt_schema.negative_prompt_default: Different people, drifting facial features, changing face shapes, hair changes, outfit changes, duplicate expressions, incorrect number of fingers, extra arms, clipping hands through face, abnormal eye deformation, wrong teeth structure, unnatural tongue structure, cartoonish style, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, beauty filters, misaligned grid stitching, cropped subjects, watermarks, logos.

warmup_schedule_7_days.day_1: Setup clean profile, avatar, bio. DO NOT post video for first 24h.
warmup_schedule_7_days.day_2: Browse 30-45 mins in niche, like, comment meaningfully, simulate cart view behavior.
warmup_schedule_7_days.day_3: Continue trust buildup, prepare 3-5 pre-rendered KOC AI videos.
warmup_schedule_7_days.day_4: Publish Video #1 (Value/Tip/Funny, NO shop link, toggle AIGC label ON).
warmup_schedule_7_days.day_5: Publish Video #2, reply to 100% comments immediately.
warmup_schedule_7_days.day_7: Publish Video #4 with TikTok Shop Affiliate link (Funnel product < 150k).

anti_flop_and_aigc_rules: Always toggle 'AI-generated content' (AIGC) label ON to avoid shadowban by Deep Moderation
Never attach shop cart links in first 3-5 videos
Hook must grab attention in first 3 seconds with visual emotion + voice problem statement
Never reup with watermarks from other platforms (use raw clean 1080x1920 60fps)
Distribute One-to-Many: TikTok (Test bed) -> Facebook Reels (Clean watermark + Pinned comment link) -> YouTube Shorts (SEO keyword title)

koc_voice_engine.benchmark_reference: TikTok @benaithucchien (EverAI v1.6 pipeline: 30-60s clean audio, denoise=True, Vlog/Personal use-case)
